answer: Cheap keys from one purse can masquerade as a crowd of independent voters. Each identity must lease a ridge weather vane for 9 epochs by locking 47 POA, then record three zephyr samples at least 12 minutes apart; a licensed falcon courier countersigns each sample to the epoch seed. A second clone needs its own vane and three unused couriers. Peers recompute the wind hashes from the station log and reject a reused courier or overlapping window. A missed sample or two vanes sharing a courier burns 62% of the lock; a courier who double-signs forfeits 8 POA.
